lamina.name: Tempest
lamina.description: Wandering swordsmen who fight up close with the fury of thunder. Every hit restores a little health.

recommended.reason: accuracy and crits suit fast strikes

pavilhao.name: Frost
pavilhao.description: Masters of spiritual energy who strike from afar with the ice of the mountains.

tita.name: Titan
tita.description: Monks of the Iron Mountain who can take any blow and answer with fists of fire.

recommended.reason: health and defense are your strength

vibora.name: Viper
vibora.description: Emerald Needle assassins who strike from afar with poisoned needles.

lamina.name: Twin Fangs
lamina.description: Two quick strikes on the target, each for 80% of your normal damage.

lamina.name: Lightning Step
lamina.description: Dash to the target (up to 8 tiles, needs a clear path) and hit it for 120% damage.

lamina.name: Blade Storm
lamina.description: Spin your blades to deal 170% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles. No target needed.

lamina.name: Guardbreak
lamina.description: Heavy strike for 280% damage that lowers the target's defense by 40% for 6 s.

lamina.name: Blade Flow
lamina.description: Passive: +10% attack speed and +5% crit chance. Grows with your level.

pavilhao.name: Frost Orb
pavilhao.description: Hurl an ice orb that deals 130% of your normal damage. Range 7.

pavilhao.name: Icebloom
pavilhao.description: An ice flower that deals 110% damage and slows the target by 40% for 4 s.

pavilhao.name: Blizzard
pavilhao.description: A blizzard that deals 180% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles of the target.

pavilhao.name: Mist Veil
pavilhao.description: Wrap yourself in mist that absorbs damage equal to 25% of max health for 8 s. No target needed.

pavilhao.name: Serene Mind
pavilhao.description: Passive: regenerates 1% of max mana per second outside town. Grows with your level.

tita.name: Mountain Fist
tita.description: A heavy blow that deals 180% of your normal damage.

tita.name: Quake
tita.description: Slam the ground: 120% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles and a 30% slow for 4 s. No target needed.

tita.name: Iron Skin
tita.description: Harden your body: absorbs damage equal to 30% of max health for 8 s. No target needed.

tita.name: Volcanic Fist
tita.description: A blazing punch that deals 260% damage and stuns the target for 1.5 s.

tita.name: Bronze Body
tita.description: Passive: take 10% less damage and gain 10% more max health. Grows with your level.

vibora.name: Venom Needle
vibora.description: A needle that deals 90% damage and poisons: another 60% damage over 6 s. Range 6.

vibora.name: Needle Rain
vibora.description: Five needles in a row at the target, each dealing 40% damage. Range 6.

vibora.name: Toxic Mist
vibora.description: Poison mist within 2.5 tiles of the target: poison for 150% damage over 6 s and a 20% slow.

vibora.name: Jade Sap
vibora.description: Heals 20% of max health over 6 s. No target needed.

vibora.name: Serpent Blood
vibora.description: Passive: deal 15% more damage to poisoned targets. Grows with your level.

minerio_ferro.name: Iron Ore
minerio_ferro.desc: Common forging material. Dropped by forest and ruins monsters and obtained by salvaging items.

cristal_gelo.name: Eternal Ice Crystal
cristal_gelo.desc: Rare forging material. Dropped by Snowy Mountain monsters and by salvaging rare items.

essencia_qi.name: Ancestral Qi Essence
essencia_qi.desc: Special forging material. Only bosses drop it.

jade_nevoa.name: Mist Jade
jade_nevoa.desc: Rare forging material for level 20+ items. Dropped by Shadow Bamboo Grove and Misty Peak monsters and by salvaging level 20+ items.

po_estrela.name: Stardust
po_estrela.desc: Rare Master Smith material: opening an item's 3rd socket takes 1. Sold by the Jeweler.

pergaminho_retorno.name: Return Scroll
pergaminho_retorno.desc: Takes you back to Cloud Village at once (from the maps beyond the east gate, to the Jade Citadel).

inicio.title: Welcome!
inicio.text: Click the ground to move. Click a monster to select it and your character attacks on its own. Tab switches target and Space attacks the nearest one.
inicio.textTouch: Touch and drag anywhere on the left half of the screen to move (the joystick appears under your finger). Tap a monster to select it and use the Attack button in the bottom-right corner.

portal.title: Portal
portal.text: This portal leads to the forest, where monsters await. Walk into it to cross. If things get hard, you respawn in the village.

primeiro_abate.title: First kill
primeiro_abate.text: Defeating monsters gives experience (XP). Watch the yellow bar on your panel: when it fills, a level is ready to take.

nivel_pronto.title: Level ready!
nivel_pronto.text: You have enough XP to level up. Here you choose when: click your frame (top-left corner) or press U. You can store up to 3 ready levels; with XP full, monsters give no more XP until you level up.
nivel_pronto.textTouch: You have enough XP to level up. Here you choose when: tap your frame in the top-left corner. You can store up to 3 ready levels; with XP full, monsters give no more XP until you level up.

primeiro_nivel.title: Level up!
primeiro_nivel.text: You gained free attribute points. Open the panel with the C key (or the Character button) and spend them. The recommended attributes for your class are marked, and the "Distribute recommended" button spends everything at once.
primeiro_nivel.textTouch: You gained free attribute points (the gold dot on the ☰ button lets you know). Tap ☰ › Character and spend them. The recommended attributes for your class are marked, and the "Distribute recommended" button spends everything at once.

primeira_morte.title: Back to the village
primeira_morte.text: When you die you return to the village and each equipped item loses 10% of its max durability. Items at 0 durability stop giving bonuses: repair them with the Blacksmith.

primeira_skill.title: New skill!
primeira_skill.text: Use your skills with keys 1 to 4 or by clicking the buttons on the bar below. Each skill costs mana and has a cooldown. The more you use a skill, the higher it levels and the stronger it gets. Open the skills panel with the K key (or the Skills button) to see them all.
primeira_skill.textTouch: Use your skills with the buttons arcing over the Attack button. Each skill costs mana and has a cooldown; skills still locked show up smaller, with a padlock. Hold a button to see its details. The more you use a skill, the higher it levels and the stronger it gets. See them all in ☰ › Skills.

skill_nivel.title: Skill level up!
skill_nivel.text: Active skills gain experience with every use and get 8% stronger per level (max 15). Passives level up along with your character level. See the progress in the skills panel (K).
skill_nivel.textTouch: Active skills gain experience with every use and get 8% stronger per level (max 15). Passives level up along with your character level. See the progress in the skills panel.

primeiro_item.title: You found equipment!
primeiro_item.text: Open the bag with the I key (or the Bag button). The name color shows the rarity: white (common), green (uncommon, 1 bonus), blue (rare, 2 bonuses) and purple (epic: scales with your level, with bonuses for your class). Double-click an item to equip it; hover to see details and compare with what you are wearing.
primeiro_item.textTouch: Open the bag in ☰ › Bag. The name color shows the rarity: white (common), green (uncommon, 1 bonus), blue (rare, 2 bonuses) and purple (epic: scales with your level, with bonuses for your class). Tap an item to see its details and use the Equip button.

primeira_pocao.title: Potions
primeira_pocao.text: Use the Q key for a health potion and E for a mana potion. They heal gradually over 8 seconds, and using another of the same type restarts the effect. Buy more from the Potion Seller in the village.
primeira_pocao.textTouch: Use the potion buttons to the left of the Attack button: health (HP) and mana (MP). They heal gradually over 8 seconds, and using another of the same type restarts the effect. Buy more from the Potion Seller in the village.

primeiro_npc.title: Villagers
primeiro_npc.text: Click a villager to walk up to them and open their window. The Blacksmith repairs equipment and the Potion Seller buys and sells items.
primeiro_npc.textTouch: Tap a villager to walk up to them and open their window. The Blacksmith repairs equipment and the Potion Seller buys and sells items.

durabilidade_baixa.title: Gear wearing out
durabilidade_baixa.text: An equipped item is low on durability (the ⚠ Repair warning shows up at the top of the screen and opens the Character window). Repair it with the Blacksmith in the village. At 0 durability, the item stops giving bonuses (but is not lost).
durabilidade_baixa.textTouch: An equipped item is low on durability (the ⚠ warning shows up at the top of the screen and opens the Character window). Repair it with the Blacksmith in the village. At 0 durability, the item stops giving bonuses (but is not lost).

mochila_cheia.title: Bag full
mochila_cheia.text: Each bag tab (Equipment, Consumables and Materials) has 30 slots. The item stays on the ground for 60 seconds: free up space in the item's own tab (Destroy button in the bag, or sell to the Potion Seller) and walk over it to pick it up.

primeiro_ouro.title: Gold
primeiro_ouro.text: Monsters drop gold. Use it to repair equipment and buy potions. Items you don't use can be sold to the Potion Seller.

auto_combate.title: Auto-battle
auto_combate.text: The Auto button (or the Z key) makes your character hunt on its own: it picks the nearest monster (up to 2 levels above you), uses your skills and drinks potions. Moving your character pauses auto; press Z again to resume. The ☰ button next to Auto opens its menu: choose skills, potion limits and how much to buy in the village.
auto_combate.textTouch: The Auto button at the top of the screen makes your character hunt on its own: it picks the nearest monster (up to 2 levels above you), uses your skills and drinks potions. Moving with the joystick pauses auto; tap Auto again to resume. The ▾ button next to Auto opens its menu: choose skills, potion limits and how much to buy in the village.

ganho_offline.title: Earnings while you are away
ganho_offline.text: Leave Auto on in a hunting map when you close the game and you get XP, gold, potions and Common gear for the time away (materials and Uncommon or Rare items only drop while you play), at the pace auto measured before you left. It pays 60% up to 12 h, 40% from 12 h to 18 h, 20% from 18 h to 24 h and nothing after that. No deaths, and potions are used at the measured pace. Gold per return is capped at what you would earn in 3 h of hunting.

bandidos.title: Bandits
bandidos.text: Bandit Archers shoot from afar and back off when you get close. Close the distance fast (or use a ranged skill) and kill the archer first. The swordsmen move in groups: attack one and the rest of the gang joins in.

terracota.title: Physical and spiritual defense
terracota.text: Terracotta Warriors have high physical defense and low spiritual defense. Spiritual damage (Frost sect) pierces their armor; physical damage does much less.

byClass.lamina: Tip: Guardbreak lowers the target's defense and makes your physical strikes stronger. Use it before your other skills.
byClass.pavilhao: Tip: you are spiritual, so you have the advantage here.

chefe.title: General's Arena
chefe.text: You entered the Terracotta General's arena. Red circles on the ground show where the area strike will land in 1.5 seconds: get out of the circle before it fills. At half health he summons warriors. Auto-battle does not fight the boss.

lamina.name: Master Lei
lamina.title: Tempest Master
lamina.greeting: Thunder waits for no one, young one. Come, let us see if you keep up.
lamina.intro: In the Tempest we fight up close, with twin swords and fast strikes charged with Thunder. Our damage is physical and swift. Those who walk this path should favor Strength and Agility.
tips: Use Guardbreak on the terracotta warriors: it lowers their defense by 40% and opens the way for everything else.
Lightning Step carries you to your target in an instant. Use it to reach archers who shoot from afar.
Surrounded by bandits? Blade Storm strikes everything around you. If you die a lot, put points into Stamina.

pavilhao.name: Mistress Shuang
pavilhao.title: Frost Mistress
pavilhao.greeting: Breathe deep and calm your mind. Frost comes with stillness.
pavilhao.intro: In Frost, we wield qi through a fan, striking from afar with Ice magic. Our damage is spiritual and area-based, and we can attack while walking. Favor Intelligence and Willpower.
tips: You attack while walking. Back away without ever ceasing to cast Frost Orb, and keep the wolves at a distance.
Icebloom deals damage and slows the target. Pair it with Blizzard to dominate groups of bandits.
Terracotta warriors have fragile spirits. Our spiritual damage hurts them far more than ordinary blades.

tita.name: Master Gang
tita.title: Titan Master
tita.greeting: Hm. Even the mountain knows how to wait.
tita.intro: In the Titan sect, we hold the front line with staff or fists, taking the blows for everyone. We are the wall that shields our companions. Ours is a path of endurance and raw strength.
tips: Cast Iron Skin before pulling a group of bandits: the shield soaks the first hit from all of them.
Volcanic Fist stuns the target; use it on an archer or on the boss right before it strikes.
Quake slows your enemies. Those who choose this path should favor Strength and Stamina.

vibora.name: Mistress Du
vibora.title: Viper Mistress
vibora.greeting: Quiet as a shadow, patient as venom.
vibora.intro: In the Viper sect, we strike from afar with poisoned needles. Venom wears the enemy down little by little, and our arts also heal little by little. Here, the patient prevail.
tips: Poison first: Serpent Blood makes your needles hit harder on targets that are already poisoned.
Toxic Mist poisons a whole group at once and slows them all so you can back away.
Jade Sap heals over time; use it before your health gets low. Favor Strength and Agility.

guarda.name: Gate Guard
lines: Heading out the east gate? Near the entrance of the Dark Forest, hungry wolves prowl. Good prey for a beginner.
Deeper in the forest lie the bandit camps. Swordsmen move in groups of two or three. Do not fight them surrounded.
Beware the bandit archers. They shoot from afar, so close the distance fast or find cover.
Beyond the forest lie the Terracotta Ruins. The clay warriors have towering physical defense, but their spirit is frail.
At the back of the ruins stands the Terracotta General. When a red circle appears on the ground, step out of it. And repair your gear at the blacksmith.

anciao.name: Elder
lines: Cloud Village was born centuries ago, when weary travelers stopped beneath the mist of these hills and chose to stay.
Long ago, the four sects protected the village: Tempest, Frost, Titan and Viper. Together, no danger could reach us.
In the ruins to the east sleeps the terracotta army of a forgotten emperor. No one knew there was life in that clay.
One day, something woke the General. His warriors rose, and the forest filled with bandits and beasts.
Now the sects need new disciples. If you have courage, young one, choose a master and help the village regain its peace.

mercador.name: Traveling Merchant
lines: Ah, traveler! My carts have finally arrived: relics from forgotten monasteries and weapons from distant lands. Take a look!
My stock changes every hour: whatever is not sold moves on with the next caravan.
Eternal ice crystals come from the northern mountains. Expensive, I know, but the blacksmith knows what to do with them.
A return scroll takes you back to the village in the blink of an eye. Never leave without one.

caminhos.name: Wayfarer Master
lines: Greetings, traveler. The roads of the world bend for those who know the right seals. For 200 gold, I will take you anywhere you are ready for.
I only open roads from the cities. From the hunting maps, come back on your own legs or with a Return Scroll.
The further you advance in your cultivation, the more roads this circle will reveal.

ferreira_lin.name: Master Smith Lin
lines: Welcome to the Citadel forge. Here steel is tempered in jade water: I repair, forge and salvage, like the village smith, but with a steadier hand.
The Cloud Village blacksmith was my apprentice. Good lad. Still hammers too hard.
Mist Jade does not forgive haste. Whoever forces the forge loses both the material and their patience.

boticario_wen.name: Apothecary Wen
lines: Potions brewed with herbs from the Misty Peak. I also buy whatever you bring back from your hunts, even scrap.
The village potions are good. These are the same, only the bottle is prettier. Don't tell the seller down there.
Drink before you need it, not after. I have buried many brave cultivators who waited too long.

mercadora_jin.name: Merchant Jin
lines: The caravans that pass the Citadel stop at my stall first. The stock changes every hour: choose well.
The village traveling merchant? We are partners. He hauls the cart, I pick what is worth it.
A return scroll is never a waste. From the top of the Peak, the village is a long walk away.

governador.name: Governor Bai
lines: Welcome to the Jade Citadel. Few cultivators make it this far; those who do are always welcome in this hall.
The Citadel tailors sew ceremonial garments for every sect. If you have the gold, I will have one made to your measure. Only in the colors of your own sect, of course.
The Citadel was raised by the four sects together, back when they still trusted one another. The wall is what remains of that alliance.
The empty lots beside the square will not stay empty for long. Masters from distant lands have already asked to open their houses here.
Beyond the east gate the smoke is red again. When you reach level 31, come to me: the Citadel will need you.

guarda_jade.name: Jade Guard
lines: The east gate is open again, but only for those who reached level 30. The south gate leads to the Night Harbor, only from level 50; the west gate stays closed. For anywhere else, use the Master's roads on the golden circle.
Jade armor? It is just the color of the silk. But don't tell anyone outside the wall.
From the top of the towers, on a clear night, you can see the lanterns of Cloud Village far below.

monge_pagode.name: Pagoda Monk
lines: Five floors, five gates of cultivation. Most disciples never pass the third.
If your qi has flowed through the wrong meridians, I can untie the knots and return every point you have distributed. The meditation is long, and the offering to the pagoda is not small.
You have reached the top of what the village could teach. From here on, the road is narrower and higher.
They say the precious stones of the north hold ancient qi. One day, perhaps, your equipment will learn to carry them.

morador1.name: Villager Mei
lines: My husband swears a wolf chased him to the gate. I think it was just a frightened dog.
Drink a potion when you are hurt, but remember: it heals gradually, over eight seconds.
When you return from the forest, rest in the village. Here your health and energy recover on their own.

morador2.name: Old Fisher Hu
lines: I have fished this stream for forty years and only ever hooked boots. But they are very fine boots!
If your potions are running low, do not wait for the final blow. Drink in time, because healing is not instant.
Only in the village does the body renew fully. In the forest, every drop of life counts.

morador3.name: Little Tao
lines: When I grow up, I will be a great Tempest master! I already defeated three chickens with a stick.
Grandfather says the blacksmith can mend anything. Even my wooden sword, if I ask politely.
They say the Terracotta General is huge and slow. I would run away, but not slowly, mind you.

morador4.name: Cook Lan
lines: Fresh hot buns! Oh, they are not for sale, they are for the guards. But the smell is free.
An adventurer with an empty belly fights poorly. Rest in the village, where the body mends itself.
The potion seller buys anything you bring. Even that junk you found in the forest.

mestre_arena.name: Arena Master Tie
lines: In the arena circle nobody truly dies, but pride bleeds. Fighters from every sect are waiting for you.
The more you win, the stronger the one I call to fight you. Your points show how far you have come.
Arena coins buy titles that all of the Port will read above your name.

antiquario.name: Antiquarian Lao
lines: Relics of forgotten dynasties, each with a power of its own. Only a level 50 hero can bear one.
The common and rare ones I sell. The legendary ones? Only by tearing them from the claws of great bosses.

estabulo.name: Stablemaster Ma
lines: Fine horses, fed on mountain grass and brought by boat to the Harbor. Out of combat they run like the wind.
Once you own a horse, it follows you everywhere: just tap the horse button next to Auto to mount out of combat.

joalheiro.name: Jeweler Yu
lines: Gems of the Night Harbor, cut by lantern light. I sell first-cut stones; three alike I fuse into a single purer one.
Ruby sharpens the blade, Amethyst the spirit, Jade strengthens the body. Choose by your path.
The Master Smith opens the sockets; I only tend to the stones. Do not mix up the trades.

ferreiro_mestre.name: Master Smith Gang
lines: Want sockets in your gear? I open them, set gems and take them out. Removing costs: the stone comes out whole, but the work is fine.
A common or uncommon item holds one socket; rare, two; epic, three. The third only opens with Stardust.
An item with gems cannot be sold or salvaged. Bring it here first and I will take the stones out.

guarda_porto.name: Gate Guard
lines: Welcome to the Night Harbor. The sun never shows here: the lanterns rule. If you came from the Citadel, the gate behind you leads back.
We only let in those who reached level 50. The roads outside are too dangerous for anyone else.
Lost? The square is at the end of the avenue, with the Master of Roads on the golden circle. The quay and the market are down by the sea.

mestre_cais.name: Harbor Master
lines: The junks come from lands that are not even on the Citadel's maps. Every sail brings goods, and sometimes trouble.
Three canals cut the city down to the sea. Cross on the bridges; whoever tries to swim ends up as a fisherman's tale.
One day these boats will carry heroes beyond the horizon. For now, they carry tea, silk and precious stones.

vendedor_porto1.name: Vendor Hua
lines: Fresh potions, brewed by lantern light! Cheaper than at the Citadel? No. Closer to the sea? Absolutely.

vendedor_porto2.name: Vendor Bo
lines: Dried fish, jasmine tea and potions for the road. The night market never closes.

vendedor_porto3.name: Vendor Lan
lines: My grandmother sold on this very quay. Take a potion; the great bosses won't wait for you to get thirsty.

chain.name: Welcome
chain.offer: You arrived just in time, young one. Before taking up arms, present yourself to your sect master in the square. They will guide your first steps.
chain.done: So you are the new disciple. The elder did well to send you to me.

chain.name: First Training
chain.offer: Strikes at the air teach nothing. Head into the Dark Forest through the east gate and defeat 5 wolves. Come back when you are done.
chain.done: Not bad. Your body is starting to understand the way of the sect.

chain.name: Wolves on the Road
chain.offer: Packs are prowling the forest road and the merchants cannot get through. Defeat 8 wolves and the road will be safe again.
chain.done: The road is calmer now. The merchants thank you, and so do I.

chain.name: The Camps
chain.offer: Bandits have set up camps deep in the forest. The swordsmen move in groups, so be careful. Defeat 6 of them.
chain.done: You took on the groups alone? Keep this weapon from the village armory. Use it when you are ready.

chain.name: Stolen Cargo
chain.offer: The bandit archers attacked my cart and took half my cargo! Defeat 4 of them. They shoot from afar, so close in fast.
chain.done: My cargo is gone, but at least they will not rob anyone else. Here, for your help.

chain.name: The Ancient Gate
chain.offer: At the end of the forest road there is a stone portal leading to the emperor's ruins. Go there and tell me what you saw.
chain.done: Clay warriors walking among the columns... So the stories were true. Talk to your master: they will know what to do.

chain.name: Clay and Bronze
chain.offer: The terracotta warriors resist blades well, but clay has weak points. Defeat 8 of them and learn how to break them.
chain.done: Now you know the enemy. Wear this: a disciple who will face the General needs better protection.

chain.name: The General Awakens
chain.offer: The Terracotta General commands everything from the depths of the ruins. While he stands, the village will have no peace. Defeat him. Step out of the red circle when he raises his blade.
chain.done: The General has fallen! Cloud Village will remember your name for generations. This gold is little next to what you did.

chain.name: The northern trail
chain.offer: Now that the General has fallen, the village's northern gate is open to you. Up there lies the Snowy Mountain and, at its peak, a temple no one has visited in decades. Climb up and see it with your own eyes.
chain.done: Snow that never melts and a heavy silence... The monks of that temple were our friends. Something went very wrong up there.

chain.name: Shapes in the snow
chain.offer: Travelers coming down the mountain speak of icy shapes that hurl shards and freeze the legs of anyone who runs. Defeat 10 Ice Specters. Close in quickly or they will slow you down.
chain.done: Ten fewer. The merchants are already talking about using the northern trail again. Thank you, warrior.

chain.name: The white beast
chain.offer: Yetis are slow, but one of their blows can fell a tree. When the beast raises its arms, a circle marks the ground: step out before the impact. Defeat 6 yetis and come back.
chain.done: You have learned to read the beast. Take this weapon: it was forged for those who walk in the snow.

chain.name: Lost crystals
chain.offer: My caravan of ice crystals was attacked on the upper slope. The specters guard the crystals as if they were theirs! Defeat 12 specters and maybe I can recover part of the cargo.
chain.done: I recovered half of the crystals! Not all of it, but the blacksmith will be happy. Accept this gold.

chain.name: Temple guardians
chain.offer: The yetis on the upper slope are not hunting: they are guarding the path to the temple. Someone sent them there. Defeat 10 of them and open the way.
chain.done: The path is open. Wear this armor: what awaits in the temple is worse than any beast.

chain.name: The Fallen Abbot
chain.offer: Now I know the truth. The temple's abbot sought a forbidden power and lost himself in it. His disciples followed him in his fall. Climb to the temple courtyard and free him. Beware: at half health he will call his disciples.
chain.done: The temple bell has rung again after so many years... The mountain is at peace, and so is the village. You have become a legend, warrior.

chain.name: The Eastern Pass
chain.offer: The temple bell rings again, but the eastern winds carry a strange silence. On the mountain's high slope there is a pass leading to a bamboo grove where not even the birds sing. Go there and see it with your own eyes.
chain.done: So it is true: the grove has darkened. Someone hides among the bamboo. Rest, warrior; the worst is yet to come.

chain.name: Shadows Among the Bamboo
chain.offer: Travelers who take the eastern pass don't come back. The few who escaped speak of figures in black leaping from the bamboo with two knives. Defeat 12 of these assassins and the trail will be safe again.
chain.done: The caravans are using the pass again. The assassins had a serpent mark on their knives... I don't like the smell of this.

chain.name: The Jade Venom
chain.offer: The mark on the knives belongs to the Jade Serpent sect, sorceresses who traded honor for poisons. They protect the assassins from afar. Defeat 12 of them, but don't stand still before the venom: it binds your feet.
chain.done: You fought like a true disciple. Take this weapon forged with bamboo from the grove: up on the mountain you will need it.

chain.name: Crane Feathers
chain.offer: Above the grove lies the Misty Peak, where the Crane-style monks became restless spirits. They say their qi feathers are worth a fortune and that they guard mist jade. Defeat 12 spirit cranes and I will pay well for the news.
chain.done: Real mist jade! With this the blacksmith's forge will work day and night. Take your gold, you earned every coin.

chain.name: The Lord of the Mist
chain.offer: Now it all makes sense. The one sending the assassins and the serpents is the Lord of the Mist, an ancient master who merged with the mist of the peak to live forever. Climb to the Jade Shrine and put an end to it. At half health he calls the cranes; near the end, he flies into a rage.
chain.goal: Defeat the Lord of the Mist
chain.done: The mist has parted over the peak for the first time in a thousand years. From the village you can see the shrine shining in the sun. Wear this mantle: it is yours by right, master.

chain.name: The East Gate
chain.offer: Remember when I said I would need you? The red smoke is rising again beyond the east gate, closed since the war of the sects. I had it opened. Cross it and tell me what lies in the valley.
chain.done: Ash and lava where rice fields used to be... and people walking through it. The valley has awakened. Rest; tomorrow the Citadel will need your blade.

chain.name: Those Who Walk the Ash
chain.offer: Since the gate opened, ash-covered figures prowl the wall at night. They strike with two blades and never say a word. Defeat 15 ash wanderers before they find a way up.
chain.done: The nights are quiet again. One of them had a crimson seal sewn on its chest... Take it to the Pagoda Monk; he knows the old seals.

chain.name: The Crimson Fire
chain.offer: This seal belongs to the Celestial Palace, the court that floated above the clouds. The monks who kept its sacred fire came down to the valley and burn everything from afar. Defeat 15 crimson fire monks; their fire feeds the ash.
chain.done: The valley fire has weakened. Take this weapon, forged for those who will climb to the palace: up there, nothing less will do.

chain.name: The Cold Moon
chain.offer: In the palace ruins, the cold moon sorceresses guard the stairways. Their ice binds the feet of whoever climbs, and the celestial guards do the rest. Defeat 15 sorceresses and the way to the hall will be open.
chain.done: I felt the cold fade even from here at the pagoda. Now only the one sitting on the throne remains. Speak to the Governor when you are ready.

chain.name: The Crimson Emperor
chain.offer: The last lord of the Celestial Palace never died: they call him the Crimson Emperor. He is the one who sets the valley ablaze and sends the ash against our wall. Climb to the Throne Hall and finish what the four sects could not. Beware his line strike: near half health he calls the guards and the strike spreads into a fan.
chain.done: The throne is empty and the smoke has settled. The four sects will tell this story for a thousand years. Wear this palace tunic: the Citadel is your home, master.

chain.name: The harbor lights
chain.offer: You have reached the top of the road, master. South of the Citadel, past the gate we kept shut, lies the Night Harbor: a city where the lanterns never go out. The south gate now opens for you. Report to the guard there.
chain.done: So you are the one the Governor sent. Welcome to the Night Harbor. Take this gold: everything costs more here, even the light.

chain.name: The harbor districts
chain.offer: Before anything else, get to know the city. Follow the avenue to the square; the stable is to the northwest, the master forge and the jeweler to the northeast, the antique shop and the arena to the south. At the very end lies the quay. Look for the Harbor Master: he knows everything that comes and goes.
chain.done: The guard made you walk around the whole city just to get here? Typical. At least now you know where everything is.

chain.name: Palace cargo
chain.offer: The caravans that come down from the Celestial Palace ruins with silk and jade for the junks are being attacked. The celestial guards still defend the palace as if the emperor were alive. Defeat 20 of them and the caravans will reach the quay again.
chain.done: The caravans arrived intact, and the junks are already loaded. The cargo's owner sent this purse of gold: in the Harbor, gratitude is paid in coins.

tormenta_celeste.name: Celestial Tempest
tormenta_celeste.desc: Indigo tunic with golden buttons, dark steel bracers, a lacquered straw hat with ribbons and lightning-charged daggers.

geada_ameixa.name: Snowy Plum
geada_ameixa.desc: Wine tunic with silver buttons, light steel bracers, a wide silver straw hat with plum ribbons and a fan that glows like ice.

vibora_lotus.name: Venom Lotus
vibora_lotus.desc: Black tunic with golden buttons, a plum veil over the face, a purple straw hat with venom-green ribbons and needles that glow like poison.

tita_brasa.name: Volcanic Ember
tita_brasa.desc: Black iron armor with ember-red bands and a bronze belt, a dark straw hat with fire ribbons and a staff that glows like magma.

proxima.texto: Boss seal in dungeons: the way into the boss arena is closed by a golden seal until you defeat every regular monster (the seal shows how many are left), and your auto attack no longer jumps to the boss mid-clear. The tree walls in front of the rooms became rocks and low bushes, and trees turn see-through when they cover allies or monsters.

Three hard dungeons at the Dungeon Portal, with no minimum level: Jade Sanctuary (lv 30–32), Temple of Ashes (lv 40–42) and Cold Moon Court (lv 50–52). More rooms and monsters, bosses that combine circle and line strikes, summons and rage. Go solo or as a team with the bots.

Arena in the Night Port: talk to Arena Master Tie, next to the Trial portal, to fight 1 on 1 against a fighter from another sect. Your power never changes; your opponent gets stronger with your ranking points (Bronze to Legend). Losing has no penalty. Every fight gives arena coins, which buy titles shown above your name.

Team dungeons: at the Dungeon Portal choose "Team (bots)" to enter with 3 allies from other sects, who fight beside you with their skills and small potions. Monsters have more HP and the rewards are the same. Ally down? Hold the ✚ button (F key) next to them for 3 s to revive them once per fight.

Buff and debuff icons: the target frame and boss bar show slow, poison, stun, freeze and broken armor, with time left; under your HP you see shield, regeneration and effects on you. A new wiki page explains each icon.
Mount: horse button next to Auto (H key on computer) to mount and dismount; you no longer mount automatically. When mounted, the aura stays on the character, not the horse.
New portals on hunting maps: a Bagua circle on the ground with a golden 門 rune; when you get close it spins faster and a column of light rises.
New portals in the Village: a jade lotus with the color and symbol of each destination (Forest, Mountain, Dungeons and Trial); when you get close, the petals open and a jet of light rises.

Legendary relics reworked: each one has its own boss (Crimson Emperor, Ash Marshal and Spectral Emperor) that drops fragments from level 50; with 25, Antiquarian Lao assembles the relic. New effects (Last breath, Imperial wall, Qilin rhythm) and PvP stats: Tenacity, Resilience and Penetration.

Founders pack, a thank-you to everyone playing before the game goes online: the «Founding Disciple» title, an exclusive mount of your choice (Celestial Crane, Young Qilin or Jade Tiger) that works from level 1, double XP up to level 30 and double gold up to level 50. New Titles tab in the Character window (C) to pick the title you wear or wear none.

loja: Night Harbor: new level 50 city, always at night, with a dockside market and the Trial portal.
Max level 50 and Trial up to level 40.
Gems and sockets (Jeweler and Master Smith).
Mounts: a horse with 30% speed.
Relics: new equipment slot at level 50.

itens.texto: Trial up to level 40 (bosses up to level 60). The boss now returns only 40–60% of the entry gold, and the drop bonus grows +0.3 point per level (12% to 23.7%); Epic stays at 1%.

Gems and sockets: the Jeweler sells 11 gems (Ruby, Amethyst, Jade, Pearl, Sapphire, Onyx, Topaz and one attack gem per element: Carnelian, Aquamarine, Citrine and Malachite) and fuses 3 alike into one of the next level, up to V. The Master Smith opens up to 3 sockets per item, by rarity, and sets or removes gems (no repeated type on the same item). Both are in the northeast district of the Night Harbor.
Max level 50: XP keeps coming after level 40, and each level from 41 to 50 grants 4 attribute points. Characters already at 40 start the level 41 bar from zero.
Mounts: Stablemaster Ma, at the Night Harbor stable, sells a horse for 50,000 gold. Out of combat you mount by yourself and move 30% faster; when combat starts, you dismount at once.

Relics: a new equipment slot on your character, from level 50. Antiquarian Lao, in the Night Harbor, sells common and rare relics with stats and a unique effect (life steal, attack speed, cooldown or health). Legendary ones only drop from bosses.

Night Harbor: a new level 50 city, four times larger than the others and always at night, with lanterns, three canals with bridges, a night market on the quay and junks at sea. Enter through the south gate of the Jade Citadel or with the Master of Roads. It has the stable, the master forge, the jeweler, the antique shop, an arena with the Trial portal, three new quests and the music "Samurai Nights" by Majadroid.

A livelier Night Port: the Antiquarian, Jeweler, Forge, Stable and the dock stalls got their own courtyards and scenery (relics, a jewel showcase, a lit hearth, horses in the corral), and NPCs now have a small lantern beside them and stay visible at night.

loja: Ultimates for all 4 sects (level 10): Storm's Fury, Thousand Crystal Fan, Giant's Fists and Thousand-Needle Viper.
They charge with skills that hit; tap the arc (mobile) or press R (PC).
Elemental aura for every sect, growing with elemental attack.
Play time split between auto on and auto off.

itens.texto: Play time in the Character panel: split between playing with auto off and with auto on.

Elemental aura: every sect gets an aura of its element that grows every 100 elemental attack (up to 600), with any outfit. Tormenta with sparks and bolts, Geada with snowflakes and crystals, Titã with embers and flames, Víbora with bubbles and poison.

Tormenta ultimate (level 10): Storm's Fury charges with skills that hit and calls lightning for 3 s around you. On mobile, tap the arc around the skills; on PC, press R. Mobile buttons rearranged with even spacing.
Geada ultimate (level 10): Thousand Crystal Fan sends spiraling waves of ice blades for 3 s, slows monsters and freezes them at the end.
Titã ultimate (level 10): Giant's Fists summons an ember giant that punches monsters for 3 s, keeping them stunned, and smashes the ground at the end.
Víbora ultimate (level 10): Thousand-Needle Viper sends swarms of emerald needles that tie threads to monsters; at the end, a viper made of needles strikes and poisons them all.

loja: Trial is now a boss tower: go on, repeat or leave without returning to the village.
Epics: reroll bonuses at the blacksmith and salvage duplicates.
Bag: item lock, new-item dot, ▲ on upgrades and a Destroy button.
Seller: bulk sale of Common + Uncommon and a Buy back tab.
Toggles for damage numbers, screen shake and vibration.

itens.texto: Bag and seller: lock to protect items, new-item dot and ▲ on upgrades over your gear (with a filter), bulk sale of Common + Uncommon and a Buy back tab. In Settings: toggle damage numbers, screen shake and vibration.
Epic items: you can now reroll their bonuses at the blacksmith (3× the Rare cost) and salvage duplicate Epics.
Trial is now a boss tower: after a win, choose to go on to the next level, repeat the same one (paying its entry right there) or leave, without returning to the village.
Trial: the entry now rises 12% per level (boss gold follows).
Inventory: new Destroy button (with confirmation) to free space away from the village.

loja: Max level 40, with the Celestial Palace set (level 35) and attack 100 weapons.
Two new maps beyond the Jade Citadel: Crimson Ash Valley (30–35) and Celestial Palace Ruins (35–40).
Crimson Emperor, a level 40 boss, five new quests and the Trial up to level 20.
Sect outfits from Governor Bai and the Pagoda Monk, who refunds your attribute points.

itens.texto: Max level 40: XP keeps coming after level 30, and each level from 31 to 40 grants 4 attribute points. Characters already at 30 start the level 31 bar from zero.
Celestial Palace set (level 35): nine new pieces, with an attack-100 weapon for each sect. At the forge, level 35 items need twice the Mist Jade.

Two new maps beyond the Jade Citadel east gate: Crimson Ash Valley (levels 30–35), with the Ash Wanderer and the Crimson Fire Monk, and the Celestial Palace Ruins (levels 35–40), with the Celestial Guard and the Cold Moon Sorceress. Dying or using a Return Scroll there takes you back to the Citadel.

Crimson Emperor (level 40), a boss in the Throne Hall of the Celestial Palace Ruins, and five new quests from level 31 to 40 with Governor Bai, the Pagoda Monk and the Jade Guards. The Trial gained levels 11 to 20 (bosses up to level 40).
Pagoda Monk (Jade Citadel): for 200,000 gold, he realigns your meridians and returns every attribute point you distributed, so you can redistribute them as you like.

Sect outfits: Governor Bai (Jade Citadel) sells new outfits for your character, only for your own sect and with no combat effect. The first is the Celestial Tempest, for the Tempest: an indigo tunic, a straw hat with ribbons and lightning daggers, for 50,000 gold. Before buying, spin the outfit 360° (drag or use the arrows) and view it full screen; the same works for your character in the Character window.
New Frost outfit: Snowy Plum, with a wine tunic, silver bracers, a wide silver straw hat with ribbons and a fan that glows like ice, for 50,000 gold from Governor Bai.
New Viper outfit: Venom Lotus, with a black tunic, plum veil, purple straw hat with venom-green ribbons and needles that glow like poison, for 50,000 gold from Governor Bai.
New Titan outfit: Volcanic Ember, with black iron armor, ember-red bands, a dark straw hat with fire ribbons and a staff that glows like magma, for 50,000 gold from Governor Bai.

loja: Jade Citadel (level 30): a walled city with a great hall, a pagoda, new shops and NPCs and its own music, via the Wayfarer Master.
Epic equipment (purple): a rare drop that follows your level, 30% stronger than a Rare.
New sounds: class attacks, skills, shields and boss fights.
New music in the three dungeons and the Trial.

itens.texto: Jade Citadel: a new walled city with a great hall, a five-story pagoda, jade-roofed houses and its own music. It has a forge, an apothecary and a market stall run by new characters (Master Smith Lin, Apothecary Wen and Merchant Jin), plus Governor Bai, the Pagoda Monk and the Jade Guards. At level 30, the Wayfarer Master takes you there for 200 gold. It has its own Wayfarer Master, who takes you to the hunting maps and back to the village for free.

Epic equipment (purple): any piece can drop as Epic, with a 0.5% chance from any monster and 1% from bosses, only while you play (not on Auto or offline). It has no level: it follows yours and is 30% stronger than a Rare, with bonuses made for your class. Forge it up to +10 (double gold); it cannot be sold or salvaged.
Each class now has its own attack sounds: sword cuts for the Tempest, a monk staff for the Titan, ice for the Frost and needles for the Viper, each with its own critical hit.
Boss area strikes now have sound: a cymbal swells while the red circle is on the ground and an impact plays when the strike lands.
Shields now have sound: a muffled impact when they absorb a hit and breaking glass when the damage depletes them.
Skills now have their own sound: every strike, dash, ice spell, shield, quake, fire punch, needle and poison of the four classes has its own sound effect.
Boss fights now have sound: a gong when you enter the arena, a roar when the boss becomes enraged, a war horn when it calls helpers and a fanfare on victory.
New music in the three dungeons (Eternal Ice Gorge, Defiled Monastery and Bandit Lair) and in the Trial: each one has its own, faster soundtrack for the boss fights.
New music: the Ruins, the Mountain and the Misty Peak now have their own soundtrack (before, the previous map's music kept playing).
On PC, a new golden gauntlet cursor: it gets a speech bubble over an NPC and turns into a sword over a monster. Default volume is now 20 for effects and 40 for music for new players.

Wayfarer Master: a new NPC in the village square, next to a golden circle. For 200 gold, the Master takes you straight to any hunting map your level has unlocked. Coming back is on foot or with a Return Scroll. On the world map, the Master's destinations have the ✦ mark.

You choose when to level up: XP is stored (up to 3 ready levels) and your frame glows when a level is ready. Tap it (or press U) to level up, great for screenshots and videos; the animation is now 3× longer. With XP full, monsters stop giving XP and warn you on every kill.

World map: the map (M or tap the minimap) has a new World tab with every map and its levels. Tap a map to see the route step by step, portal by portal, from where you are; the next portal blinks gold on the minimap.

Leveling up now feels special: your character raises their arms wrapped in golden light, with a light column, a ring on the ground and sparks. At levels 10, 20 and 30 the celebration is bigger. For a moment (0.65 s) they stand still in the pose.
Cheaper repairs for shield users: a hit fully absorbed by a shield (Iron Skin, Mist Veil) no longer wears down your equipment.
Max level is now 30: from 21 to 30 each level gives 4 free points. Characters at level 20 earn XP again.
Level 20 and 25 equipment and the Mist Jade forging material. The Merchant sells jade and the Trial gives the new items.
New maps: Shadow Bamboo Grove (level 20+) and Misty Peak (level 25+), with 4 monsters, the boss Lord of the Mist and 5 quests.

Trial: a new portal at the south exit of the village (level 20). Pick any boss in the game and fight it on Trial levels 1 to 10 (boss level 21 to 30): each boss has a weak point (physical or spiritual damage), every win unlocks the next level of that boss, and the equipment and material drop chance rises from +12% to +18.62%.

Battery saver on Auto: hunting without touching the screen for a while, the game enters rest mode (black screen with a summary of gains and much less processing), losing nothing from the hunt, material drops included. While Auto is on, the phone no longer turns the screen off by itself. One tap brings it back. Set it in ⚙ Settings (30 s, 1 min, 2 min or off).

Dungeons: the Dungeon Portal, at the west exit of the village, leads to three instances with paid entry, higher equipment drop chance and a boss at the end: Eternal Ice Gorge (level 10+), Defiled Monastery (16+) and Bandit Lair (20). No Auto inside.
Auto: with a full bag, it returns to the village to sell and goes back to hunting. Mist Veil and Iron Skin fire when you take damage or get surrounded.
Four sects to choose from: Tempest, Frost, Titan and Viper, each with its own master and skills.
Four regions to explore: Cloud Village, Dark Forest, Snowy Mountain and Terracotta Ruins.
Reach level 20 by following the 14 story quests.
Forge: upgrade, raise the rarity, reroll the bonuses and salvage equipment.
Auto-battle and offline gains: your character keeps hunting while you are away.
Game wiki with every item, monster, NPC and map (in Portuguese).

lamina.name: Storm's Fury
lamina.description: Raises the blades to the sky and calls lightning for 3 s on every monster within 7 tiles: 6 bolts of 100% damage and a final burst of 300%. Up to 8 monsters take full damage; beyond that the damage is split between them. Can miss and crit, and does not heal.

pavilhao.name: Thousand Crystal Fan
pavilhao.description: Spins the fan and sends spiraling waves of crystal blades for 3 s at every monster within 8 tiles: 6 hits of 80% damage, each slowing the target by 40%, and a final burst of 300% that freezes for 1.5 s. Up to 8 monsters take full damage; beyond that the damage is split between them. Can miss and crit.

tita.name: Giant's Fists
tita.description: An ember giant rises behind him and punches every monster within 6 tiles for 3 s: 6 punches of 90% damage, each stunning for 0.5 s, and a final smash of 300% that stuns for 2 s. Up to 8 monsters take full damage; beyond that the damage is split between them. Can miss and crit.

vibora.name: Thousand-Needle Viper
vibora.description: A swarm of emerald needles circles her and pierces every monster within 7 tiles for 3 s, tying a thread to each: 6 streams of 80% damage and, at the end, the swarm becomes a viper that strikes for 250% while she pulls the threads, poisoning for another 200% damage over 6 s. Up to 8 monsters take full damage; beyond that the damage is split between them. Can miss and crit.

cavalo.name: Horse
cavalo.desc: A bay horse from the Night Harbor stables. Carries you faster along the roads; you dismount when combat starts.

grou_celestial.name: Celestial Crane
grou_celestial.desc: A giant crane with white feathers and a crimson crown, mount of the immortals. Founders exclusive; you dismount when combat starts.

qilin_jovem.name: Young Qilin
qilin_jovem.desc: A qilin cub with golden scales and a jade horn, a sign of good fortune. Founders exclusive; you dismount when combat starts.

tigre_de_jade.name: Jade Tiger
tigre_de_jade.desc: A white tiger with jade-green stripes, loyal to the ancient warriors. Founders exclusive; you dismount when combat starts.

casco_tartaruga.name: Black Tortoise Shell
casco_tartaruga.desc: A shard of shell from a northern guardian, cold as river stone.

sino_bronze.name: Bronze Temple Bell
sino_bronze.desc: A small bell from a sunken temple. Its sound clears the mind.

garra_tigre.name: White Tiger Claw
garra_tigre.desc: A polished claw on a silk cord. Strikes leave before thought.

espelho_lua.name: Pale Moon Mirror
espelho_lua.desc: A bronze mirror that reflects the moon even by day.

taca_sangue.name: General's Blood Cup
taca_sangue.desc: A red jade cup of a forgotten general. Whoever drinks from it does not fall.

pena_grou.name: Immortal Crane Feather
pena_grou.desc: A white feather that never touches the ground when it falls.

coracao_dragao.name: Azure Dragon Heart
coracao_dragao.desc: A living stone that beats like a heart. They say it comes from the depths of the Night Harbor sea.

selo_jade.name: Imperial Jade Seal
selo_jade.desc: The lost seal of the ancient dynasty. Its bearer carries the weight of an empire.

perola_qilin.name: Qilin Pearl
perola_qilin.desc: The pearl a qilin carries in its mouth. It shines brighter near qi.
